entries.reason: Production task, dependency, scheduler, capacity and event state uses one typed Protobuf binary schema while domain-owned context and receipts use the shared dynamic message.
entries.schema: production:queue version 8 is ProductionQueueSave with typed records and shared DynamicValue fields only for open-ended domain context and receipts.
entries.version: Binary writers emit version 8; versions 1-7 remain readable through the legacy JSON importer.
entries.migration: Legacy JSON restores into a detached WorkQueue before recapture as version 8 binary; the binary envelope uses the shared digest and typed header.
entries.unknown_fields: Binary restore rejects unknown Protobuf fields recursively, invalid enum values, duplicate identities and malformed dependency graphs.
entries.restore_atomicity: Validation and reconstruction occur in a detached WorkQueue; the live queue is replaced only after the complete image and digest pass.

entries.reason: The production module exposes typed binary persistence alongside its existing script and compatibility JSON boundary.

trim.absent_profile: No L1-L4 trim claim is made for this change.

entries.thread_affinity: Snapshot and restore run on the WorkQueue owner thread and invoke no callbacks except the supplied digest provider.
cost_notes: Binary save and restore cost linear time in retained tasks, events and dynamic payload bytes per snapshot.
